name: Arcane Fist
description:
About This Game

Master the art of elemental combat in Arcane Fist, an anime-inspired 3D platform fighter. Wield the power of fire, water, earth, and more as you battle to knock opponents off the stage in chaotic 3v3 team brawls or intense 1v1 duels. With new ranks, badges, and titles to earn added regularly, there’s always a reason to come back for one more match.

Arcane Mayhem

Wield the elements in this 3D platform fighter that lets you create your own epic anime battles. This combat system doesn’t rely on complicated button combinations or managing meters, but being able to improvise and adapt to the flow of battle. Join up with two friends and rise through the ranks in competitive 3v3 matches, or hone your skills in 1v1 duels.

Admire the View

Don’t lose your footing! Each map presents different challenges and opportunities to play around. Additional maps added post-launch continue to add depth and unpredictability to battle.

Choose Your Fighter

Choose your fighter and master their element. There's no pay to win here! Skill is the only thing you need to conquer the competition.
